title: Song Manifest
description: Tracks a poem through all stages of the Music Creator pipeline: source, lyrics, music, visuals, animation, and final assembly.

id.description: Unique identifier — a slug derived from the poem's Russian title

title_en.description: Poem title translated to English (optional until needed)

url.description: URL of the web page where the poem was found

title.description: Original title as it appears on the source

original_text.description: Full original text of the poem

lyrics.description: Adapted lyrics for Suno AI music generation

adapted_text.description: Poem text adapted into singable lyrics

suno_prompt.description: Natural language prompt describing the desired song

suno_tags.description: Comma-separated style/genre tags for Suno, e.g. 'genre:pop, mood:melancholic, instruments:piano'

suno_url.description: Link to the song on Suno

audio_file.description: Relative path to the local audio file (e.g. 'audio/track.mp3')

notes.description: Observations about the result — what worked, what to iterate

scenes.description: Visual scenes that tell the poem's story

description.description: Narrative description of what happens in this scene

image_prompt.description: Prompt for generating the first frame of this scene

animation_hint.description: How to animate this scene — camera movement, effects, transitions (e.g. 'slow pan right', 'zoom in on eyes', 'particle fade')

image_file.description: Relative path to the generated first-frame image

video_file.description: Relative path to the generated animation/video clip

timeline.description: Chronological log of work done on this poem

date.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this stage was completed or updated

notes.description: Free-text notes about decisions, iterations, ideas
